title: CDL license standards practice questions
description: Free CDL practice questions on 49 CFR Part 383: the single license, CLPs, vehicle groups, endorsements, disqualifications and tests, with sources.

questions.topic: Who the rules cover and the single license
questions.question: A driver holds a commercial driver's license issued by a Canadian Province under the Canadian National Safety Code. Under the single license provision of 383.21, as the footnote to 383.23 explains, what may this driver obtain from a U.S. State?

options.A: Nothing: the driver is prohibited from obtaining a non-domiciled CDL or any other type of driver's license from a State
options.B: A non-domiciled CDL for interstate trips only
options.C: A non-commercial State license for personal driving
options.D: A CLP for behind-the-wheel training

questions.explanation: The footnote says that "under the single license provision of § 383.21, a driver holding a commercial driver's license issued under the Canadian National Safety Code or a new Licencia Federal de Conductor issued by Mexico is prohibited from obtaining a non-domiciled CDL, or any other type of driver's license, from a State or other jurisdiction in the United States."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.23, Commercial driver's license (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Under 383.31(b), which item must a CDL holder's written notice to the employer about a traffic conviction contain?

options.A: The name of the arresting officer
options.B: A copy of the court's sentencing transcript
options.C: An indication whether the violation was in a commercial motor vehicle
options.D: The employer's USDOT number

questions.explanation: "The notification to the employer must be made in writing" and its listed contents include "Indication whether the violation was in a commercial motor vehicle", along with the driver's name, license number, date of conviction, offense, location and signature.

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.31, Notification of convictions for driver violations (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Which of these events does 383.33 require an employee to report to the current employer?

options.A: Receiving a parking ticket
options.B: Losing the right to operate a commercial motor vehicle in a State, for any period
options.C: Renewing a driver's license on time
options.D: Moving to a new address in the same State

questions.explanation: 383.33 covers each employee "who loses the right to operate a commercial motor vehicle in a State or jurisdiction for any period", as well as suspensions, revocations, cancellations and disqualifications; the employee "shall notify his/her current employer".

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.33, Notification of driver's license suspensions (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: What does 383.35(f) require the employer to tell a CMV driver applicant before the application is submitted?

options.A: That the applicant must pay for the background check
options.B: That previous employers will not be contacted
options.C: That only the last 3 years of work history will be reviewed
options.D: That the employment history information may be used, and previous employers may be contacted, to investigate the applicant's work history

questions.explanation: "Before an application is submitted, the employer shall inform the applicant that the information he/she provides in accordance with paragraph (c) of this section may be used, and the applicant's previous employers may be contacted for the purpose of investigating the applicant's work history."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.35, Notification of previous employment (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Under 383.25(d), when is the issuance of a CLP a precondition for a driver who already holds a CDL?

options.A: Every time the CDL is renewed
options.B: When the CDL holder seeks an upgrade that requires a skills test
options.C: Only when the holder moves to a new State
options.D: Never; a CLP is only for first-time applicants

questions.explanation: "The issuance of a CLP is a precondition to the initial issuance of a CDL. The issuance of a CLP is also a precondition to the upgrade of a CDL if the upgrade requires a skills test."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.25, Commercial learner's permit (CLP) (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: A State issued a CLP for a period of less than one year. What does 383.25(c) say about renewing it?

options.A: It may be renewed, provided the CLP is not valid for more than one year from the date of initial issuance
options.B: It may never be renewed
options.C: It may be renewed any number of times for up to four years
options.D: It may be renewed only after the holder retakes the skills test

questions.explanation: "CLPs issued for a period of less than one year may be renewed provided the CLP is not valid for more than one year from the date of initial issuance."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.25, Commercial learner's permit (CLP) (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: When a CLP holder drives a passenger vehicle, where does 383.25(a)(1) allow the accompanying CDL holder to be?

options.A: Anywhere on the bus, as long as the CDL holder is on board
options.B: In a vehicle following the bus
options.C: At the rear door, to watch the passengers
options.D: Directly behind, or in the first row behind, the driver

questions.explanation: The CDL holder must be in the front seat next to the CLP holder "or, in the case of a passenger vehicle, directly behind or in the first row behind the driver and must have the CLP holder under observation and direct supervision."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.25, Commercial learner's permit (CLP) (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: A CLP holder with a passenger (P) endorsement is driving a CMV. Under 383.25(a)(5)(i), who may ride as passengers?

options.A: Any paying passengers, if the bus is less than half full
options.B: Members of the CLP holder's family
options.C: Federal/State auditors and inspectors, test examiners, other trainees, and the accompanying CDL holder
options.D: Students on a school trip, if a teacher is aboard

questions.explanation: "A CLP holder with a P endorsement is prohibited from operating a CMV carrying passengers, other than Federal/State auditors and inspectors, test examiners, other trainees, and the CDL holder accompanying the CLP holder".

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.25, Commercial learner's permit (CLP) (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Under 383.91(c)(1), what may a driver who has passed the knowledge and skills tests for a combination vehicle (Group A) also operate?

options.A: A heavy straight vehicle (Group B) or a small vehicle (Group C), provided he/she possesses the requisite endorsement(s)
options.B: Only other Group A combination vehicles
options.C: Any passenger vehicle, without a passenger endorsement
options.D: A Group B vehicle, but only after passing a new skills test

questions.explanation: "A driver who has passed the knowledge and skills tests for a combination vehicle (Group A) may operate a heavy straight vehicle (Group B) or a small vehicle (Group C), provided that he/she possesses the requisite endorsement(s)".

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.91, Commercial motor vehicle groups (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: For the driving test, what does 383.91(b) count as a representative vehicle for a given vehicle group?

options.A: Only a vehicle supplied by the State testing office
options.B: Any commercial motor vehicle which meets the definition of that vehicle group
options.C: Only the heaviest vehicle type in that group
options.D: A vehicle the applicant has driven for at least 1 year

questions.explanation: "For purposes of taking the driving test in accordance with § 383.113, a representative vehicle for a given vehicle group contained in § 383.91(a), is any commercial motor vehicle which meets the definition of that vehicle group."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.91, Commercial motor vehicle groups (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: According to the opening of 383.91(a), for which commercial motor vehicle group(s) must each driver applicant possess and be tested on the required knowledge and skills?

options.A: Group C only, whatever CDL is sought
options.B: All three groups, in every case
options.C: The group of the vehicle the applicant owns
options.D: The group(s) for which he/she desires a CDL

questions.explanation: "Each driver applicant must possess and be tested on his/her knowledge and skills, described in subpart G of this part, for the commercial motor vehicle group(s) for which he/she desires a CDL."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.91, Commercial motor vehicle groups (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Under 383.153(a)(9)(vii), on what condition may a State use additional codes for additional groupings of endorsements on a CDL?

options.A: FMCSA approves each code in writing
options.B: Each code is a single letter not already in use
options.C: Each such discretionary code is fully explained on the front or back of the CDL document
options.D: The codes are used only on intrastate licenses

questions.explanation: States may use, "At the discretion of the State, additional codes for additional groupings of endorsements, as long as each such discretionary code is fully explained on the front or back of the CDL document."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.153, Information on the CLP and CDL documents and applications (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: An applicant takes the Group A skills test in a combination vehicle whose power unit and towed unit are connected with a pintle hook. What restriction does 383.95(d) require on the CDL, if issued?

options.A: Restricted to intrastate operation
options.B: Restricted from operating a CMV equipped with any type of air brakes
options.C: Restricted from operating any Group B vehicle
options.D: Restricted from operating a tractor-trailer combination connected by a fifth wheel that requires a Group A CDL

questions.explanation: With a "pintle hook or other non-fifth wheel connection, the State must indicate on the CDL, if issued, that the person is restricted from operating a tractor-trailer combination connected by a fifth wheel that requires a Group A CDL."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.95, Restrictions (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Under 383.93(a)(1), to whom shall the State issue CDL endorsements?

options.A: Only to drivers who successfully complete the tests
options.B: To any driver who pays the endorsement fee
options.C: To any driver whose employer asks for the endorsement
options.D: To drivers who have held a CDL for at least 2 years

questions.explanation: Drivers of the listed vehicle types "must pass specialized tests to obtain each endorsement. The State shall issue CDL endorsements only to drivers who successfully complete the tests."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.93, Endorsements (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: A driver was reinstated by a State after a lifetime disqualification for a Table 1 offense, and is later convicted of another disqualifying offense in 383.51(b)(1) through (8). What does 383.51(a)(6) say?

options.A: The driver is disqualified for 10 more years
options.B: The driver may be reinstated again after a second rehabilitation program
options.C: The driver must not be reinstated
options.D: The driver is disqualified for 3 years

questions.explanation: "Any person who has been reinstated in accordance with this provision and who is subsequently convicted of a disqualifying offense described in paragraphs (b)(1) through (8) of this section (Table 1 to § 383.51) must not be reinstated."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.51, Disqualification of drivers (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: How does 383.51(a)(5) say a new disqualification period relates to any previous periods of disqualification?

options.A: It runs at the same time as them
options.B: It must be in addition to them
options.C: It replaces them
options.D: It is shortened by the time already served

questions.explanation: "The disqualification period must be in addition to any other previous periods of disqualification."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.51, Disqualification of drivers (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: When determining first and subsequent violations under 383.51(a)(4), which convictions for offenses listed in Tables 1 through 4 must be counted?

options.A: Only convictions while driving a CMV
options.B: Only convictions from the last 12 months
options.C: Each conviction resulting from a separate incident, whether committed in a CMV or non-CMV
options.D: Only convictions in the driver's home State

questions.explanation: "For purposes of determining first and subsequent violations of the offenses specified in this subpart, each conviction for any offense listed in Tables 1 through 4 to this section resulting from a separate incident, whether committed in a CMV or non-CMV, must be counted."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.51, Disqualification of drivers (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Within what period does Table 4 to 383.51 (violations of out-of-service orders) count a second conviction in a separate incident?

options.A: A 10-year period
options.B: A 3-year period
options.C: A 12-month period
options.D: The driver's whole lifetime

questions.explanation: Table 4 sets periods "For a second conviction in a separate incident within a 10-year period while operating a CMV", and the same 10-year window applies to a third or subsequent conviction.

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.51, Disqualification of drivers (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: Under 383.135(a)(3), what follows when a driver applicant fails the combination vehicle portion of the knowledge test?

options.A: The applicant receives a Group A CDL with a manual transmission restriction
options.B: The applicant must wait 1 year before retesting
options.C: The applicant receives an air brake restriction
options.D: The applicant must not be issued a Group A CLP or CDL

questions.explanation: "A driver applicant who fails the combination vehicle portion of the knowledge test (scores less than 80 percent correct) must not be issued a Group A CLP or CDL."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.135, Passing knowledge and skills tests (as of Nov 3, 2026)

questions.question: An applicant passed the pre-trip inspection segment of the skills test, failed basic vehicle control, and then had the CLP renewed. What does 383.133(c)(6)(ii) require?

options.A: Only the basic vehicle control segment must be retaken
options.B: All three segments of the skills test must be retaken
options.C: Only the on-road segment remains to be taken
options.D: The knowledge tests must be retaken, but no skills segments

questions.explanation: "Scores for the passed segments of the test are only valid during initial issuance of the CLP. If the CLP is renewed, all three segments of the skills test must be retaken."

source.title: eCFR: 49 CFR 383.133, Test methods (as of Nov 3, 2026)
